title: Feather Farming
description: Prevents farmland from being trampled into dirt if you are wearing boots enchanted with Feather Falling.
body:
# 🪶Feather Farming 🌾

A lightweight, vanilla-friendly mod that protects your crops from accidental trampling if you are wearing the right gear!

### ✨ Features
* **Trample Protection:** Jumping on farmland will no longer turn it back into dirt.
* **Feather Falling Synergy:** The mechanic automatically works if your boots are enchanted with **Feather Falling (I-IV)**.
* **Mob-Friendly:** Works for players and any other living entities wearing enchanted boots.

### 🛠️ Compatibility
* Designed specifically for **Minecraft 1.21.1**
* Powered by **NeoForge**
* Server-side friendly (works perfectly if installed only on the server, but can be used in singleplayer too).

_See the example in Gallery_
